remarks: At the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, surrounded by 2.7 acres of privacy, 39 Running Brook Lane combines gracious living with everyday convenience, moments from top schools, parks, Metro North and more. Soaring ceilings, and beautifully proportioned rooms make for inviting yet impressive everyday living and entertaining. The custom Deane kitchen anchors the home with top-tier appliances, a butler's pantry, walk-in pantry, and a sunlit circular breakfast area that flows seamlessly into the family room with fireplace. Formal living and dining rooms extend to bluestone patios, enhancing effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. A richly paneled study, flexible first-floor guest suite or office, two powder rooms, and a well-appointed laundry room complete the main level. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite offers dual bathrooms and three custom walk-in closets, while four additional bedrooms and three full baths provide generous accommodations for family and guests. The walk-out lower level expands the lifestyle appeal with a brand-new sauna and Himalayan salt room, plus substantial space for a gym, media room, or recreation. Recent improvements include a brand-new high-efficiency boiler, freshly painted interiors and exterior and a resealed driveway. This is one you have to see to truly appreciate!
